Each line is its own quantile, so the stages' p95 need not add up to the whole query's. Approximate: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing, and delta points from one process can arrive out of order (#792). panels.description: Qdrant requests retried per hour after a transient error, by client operation and error type. The error type is the class of the error behind the retry, taken from inside the ResponseHandlingException the Qdrant client wraps transport errors in: RemoteProtocolError for a keep-alive connection the tunnel closed while idle, ConnectError for a refused connection, ReadTimeout for a request that waited out qdrant.timeout, 300 s by default. Each retry reconnects after a pause of 0.5 s times the attempt number, which a search spends in the search stage. Approximate, and low for sparse series: increase() needs two samples of a series inside its window, so a series' first sample, and any series seen only once in the window, add nothing. Delta points from one process can arrive out of order, and totals then come out low (#792).
